claims.text: A Royal Court statement datelined Riyadh 24 Dhu al-Qa'da 1432 / 22 October 2011 says King Abdullah mourns Crown Prince Sultan bin Abdulaziz, Deputy Prime Minister, Minister of Defence and Aviation and Inspector General, who died at dawn that day, Saturday 24/11/1432 AH, outside the Kingdom after an illness. The funeral prayer is set for after Asr on Tuesday 27/11/1432 AH at Imam Turki bin Abdullah Mosque in Riyadh.
claims.locator: Dateline; Royal Court statement, paragraph 1; trailer (filed 07:25 Makkah time)
claims.uncertainty: The place of death is given only as outside the Kingdom. He is styled Crown Prince at his death, so this statement is the evidence for the end of his crown-princeship.
